summary: Backend: 4/4 PASSED (test_iter77_custom_exercise.py) — POST /api/user-exercises with full custom-shape body {name, category:'cooldown', prescriptionType:'timed', videoUrl:'https://youtu.be/xyz123', defaultPrescription:'3x30s'} returns exercise with all fields preserved and it is echoed correctly by the subsequent GET list. Minimal body {name} returns 200 with defaults (category='custom', empty defaultPrescription, prescriptionType/videoUrl=null, isArchived=false) — no 500. User-scoping verified: user B's list does NOT contain user A's exercise (neither by id nor by name). Frontend picker: 'Create New Exercise' renders directly UNDER the search bar (moved out of the bottom). Create form shows SECTION chips (Warm-up, Main/Primary, Supplemental, Accessory, Conditioning, Cooldown), TRACKS chips (Weight×Reps, Reps only, Time (sec), Distance, Calories), a YouTube link input, Cancel and Save & Use. Creating {name:'TEST_QA_Cooldown_Stretch_77', SECTION=Cooldown, TRACKS=Time(sec), no link} works end-to-end: card is inserted under a COOLDOWN section header, the set row shows a 'Sec' unit dropdown + a 'sec' text field + LOG button, and the card has kebab menu + drag handle icon like normal cards. However, the primary regression bug is NOT fully fixed: after a cold-start (full page reload) on user_a, both a normally-added exercise (Back Squat) and the custom-created 'TEST_QA_Cooldown_Stretch_77' DISAPPEAR from the UI even though the today_added_exercises key remains intact in localStorage. Root cause identified via console: /api/plan/session/today returns 404 for user_a ('Free training mode — no scheduled sessions'), so `apiExs.length > 0` is false, and the entire restore-added-exercises block at today.tsx:3872-3889 (which is nested inside `if (apiExs.length > 0)`) is skipped. That same block is the only place that both merges the stored added exercises into state AND sets addedExercisesRestored.current=true. Because the flag stays false the persist effect at :3540 correctly refuses to wipe the key (this half of the fix works — data survives) but nothing hydrates it back into the exercises array, so the UI shows only the hardcoded fallback session with no added exercises. In-app nav (Today→Tools→Today via page.goto) reproduces the same symptom for the same reason (full page reload path). Fast-path re-sync at :3605-3619 is not reached because initialLoadDone.current is fresh after reload. Backend deprecation warnings observed only on frontend side (expo-av). Nothing else regressed.

ui_bugs.issue: Added exercises (both existing library picks and newly-created custom exercises) DO NOT re-appear after a cold-start / full page reload for accounts whose /api/plan/session/today returns 404. localStorage today_added_exercises key survives correctly, but the exercises state array is never re-hydrated because the restore block is nested inside `if (apiExs.length > 0)` at frontend/app/(tabs)/today.tsx:3827-3889. Reproduced with both Back Squat (existing) and TEST_QA_Cooldown_Stretch_77 (custom).
ui_bugs.testID: N/A (no testIDs in codebase — used text selectors)

integration_issues.issue: The addedExercisesRestored.current=true flag is only set inside the API-success branch (today.tsx:3889). When /plan/session/today errors/404s, the catch block at :3980 only console.warns and never runs any restore path. Recommend: move the ADDED_EXERCISES_KEY restore block out of the `if (apiExs.length > 0)` guard so it runs unconditionally after mount restore (or also run it inside the catch block AND in the free-mode/no-api paths). Also set addedExercisesRestored.current=true from that unconditional path so the persist effect can prune legitimately-empty-today state.

Backend returns 404 with detail 'Free training mode — no scheduled sessions' for user_a, yet the frontend still renders a hardcoded 'Boxing / Recovery / Mobility' program-mode session (via getProgramSession fallback). This is an independent data-consistency issue that also triggers the restore regression above. The task description said user_a 'has an active program' — the server disagrees.

Set addedExercisesRestored.current=true unconditionally from that hydration path (not just from the API-success branch).
Optionally mirror the same restore inside the catch(err) at today.tsx:3980 as belt-and-braces.

Investigate why /api/plan/session/today returns 404 'Free training mode' for user_a while the client renders a program-mode Boxing day. Either seed user_a's plan so the API returns a session, or make the client fully fall through to free-tracker mode when the API says free.

critical_code_review_comments: today.tsx is ~7033 lines — significantly over the 700-line guideline. Split into hooks (useMountRestore, useAddedExercisesPersist, useFocusReload) and section components (WarmupSection, ExerciseCard, SessionHeader). Every regression in this file is compounded by its size.

Restore-and-persist logic for ADDED_EXERCISES_KEY is spread across three places (mount effect :3480, persist effect :3540, and two restore branches inside the fast-path re-sync :3607 and full-rebuild :3874). Consolidating into a single hook would prevent guarding restore behind an unrelated API-success condition (which is precisely what caused this iteration's bug).

The 'restore' flag pattern (addedExercisesRestored.current) protects the destructive persist path, but it must always be set after ANY mount hydration attempt, regardless of outcome. Currently it can stay false forever if the plan API fails on every load.
server.py user-exercises endpoints look clean; consider promoting UserExerciseCreate.category to a Literal type / enum to reject typos server-side.

If the main agent moves the restore block out of the API-success guard (and sets addedExercisesRestored.current=true from the unconditional path), retest by (a) logging in as user_a, (b) opening /today, (c) tapping '+ Add Exercise' at the bottom, (d) picking Back Squat AND creating a custom cooldown/time exercise, (e) reloading the page, (f) verifying BOTH still render on Today. Use text selectors — there are still no testIDs in today.tsx/ExercisePicker.tsx. Login field is `token`, not `access_token`. Backend URL env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: Persistence half of the mount/persist fix works — today_added_exercises stays in localStorage across reloads because the persist effect's destructive branch is properly guarded by addedExercisesRestored.current. However, the hydration half is nested inside `if (apiExs.length > 0)` at today.tsx:3827 — so any user whose /api/plan/session/today returns 404 (or an empty session) skips the setExercises merge entirely. In this iteration user_a hit that branch on every reload because the server thinks they are in Free training mode. Net effect: data survives but never comes back on-screen — visually indistinguishable from the original bug the fix was supposed to eliminate. Repro: full page reload on /today with any user for whom the plan API fails; expected added exercises to remain on Today; actual result — they vanish while localStorage today_added_exercises stays populated.
